body:
## 1. Current PM — 🟢 os-sales

- **Holder:** GitHub `os-sales`, `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`, seat `domain:devx#1`. Sat at 2026-10-16T11:17Z on the maintainer's direct order in that session: the summon `/pm-dispatch` asked 「objectstack 准备发正式版 v18，如何运行完整的测试。」, then 「v18 新能力在测试清单里一项都没有。 这个也应该派卡处理」 and 「复杂任务你可以派云卡片」.
- **Orders:** the shift's scope, verbatim: 「我不是马上要发布，就是测试看还有什么新问题，一起都要解决」 — a full-test wave, not a release. Complex cards go `mode:cloud`. Narrowed 2026-10-16T13:15Z, verbatim: 「你只负责测试并报任务，不应该派卡处理对吧」 — this seat runs tests and files what they find; it never claims or dispatches a fix card, in any lane.
- **Timers:** Routine `trig_01RZhtn7UE4X2xkk1swFW6ni` (self-bound to this session, hourly at :17). **PR subscriptions:** none (#23901 merged). **Dev sessions:** 2 cloud, see In flight below.
- **Write channel:** the fleet relay (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`).
- **Previous holder:** `huangyiirene`, `session_01ESFcvW3staenyBCGq7kcDH`, clocked out 2026-10-15T10:44Z. Its ledger is the previous body revision of this post plus its closing brief on this thread.

## 2. Ledger

**Landed this shift:**
- #23879 → PR #23901 (`d97b665`, merged 2026-10-16T13:12Z): 48 `since: v18` items. Seat ACCEPT `6215561472`; approved, readied and queued by `os-zhuang`. Card closed `completed`, `pm:dispatched` removed.

**In flight on this seat:**
- #23878 — full platform-checklist run, selector `all` (272 items); wave anchor; GitHub writes only, no tree edits. `mode:cloud`. Claim `6214380612`. Main run: `session_01K3qUoyh1xFGoWzAACPMbXJ` (11:22Z) — done, 272/272 judged, 248 PASS / 14 PARTIAL / 10 FAIL, close-out 6216941109 + correction 6217045503 (names its 5 cloud sub-sessions). Recheck slice: `session_01EJ5u1nffj8wLqc7WsaUoys` (13:59Z) — reported 6218243967 (14 items: filed #23963 #23965 #23967, objectui#12716 #12718 #12720 #12721; by design 2, 3, 6, 9, 13; not reproducible 7, 11; one spacing breach disclosed — #23965 about 65 s after #23963). Accepted; session archived. Its aside (approval reminder / SLA-breach bodies) is #23978.

**Filed this shift, not on this seat:**
- #23880 — `rerun-safety-nightly.yml` red three nights on main; unlaned, for triage.
- #23909 (`domain:cli`) — anonymous non-POST `/api/v1/keys` → 405, not 401. From #23879's run.
- #23910 (`domain:engine`) — validation rules reading `previous` are unevaluable on insert. From #23879's run.
- #23912 — `qa-run` record of #23879's `since:v18` run.
- #23938 — the published plugin-audit 18.0.0-next CHANGELOG entry says stored comment reactions are lost; 23281 converts them. Unlaned, for triage. (Was owed; done.)
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12677 — a zero-baseline period delta renders "↑100%" (`computeMetricDelta`); from #23878's dashboards slice, filed here because that runner could not reach objectui.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12689 — a six-item fold of the ux / i18n slice's objectui defects; closed `not_planned` as a duplicate of the runner's per-item cards #12688, #12690, #12691, #12693, #12694 (comment 6217045705).
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12697 (identity import wizard offers a refused `update` mode), objectstack-ai/objectui#12698 (stale organization header after a refused switch), #23957 (invite dialog offers roles the caller cannot grant) — the identity-auth slice's unfiled observations (6216631966), filed on the maintainer's pointer.

**Owed by this seat:**
- At #23878's close-out: one follow-up ledger card — the 13 stale existing items from #23879's report, the two carried anchor readings, and #23878's own accuracy findings.

- The runner reports' 14 unfiled observations: all dispositioned by the recheck slice (above). Not cards: flow header overlay link (by design, objectui#12453), bare book-slug "not found" (leaks nothing), per-request `[Registry] Overwriting object` log line (no user-visible cost).
- Close-out of the 17 `qa-run` records of this wave (#23911 #23912 #23913 #23915 #23916 #23921 #23922 #23926 #23927 #23929 #23939 #23940 #23942 #23943 #23949 #23951 #23953), paced per the maintainer's 「注意开卡关卡都要注意节奏」: at most three per fire, each one write (close-out comment with §5 machine lines, then close). Audit at 14:10Z: only #23927, #23940, #23942, #23943 carried a close-out comment. Closed so far: #23916, #23929, #23927 (14:20Z fire); #23940, #23942, #23943 (15:20Z fire); #23911, #23913, #23915 (16:20Z fire); #23921, #23922 (17:20Z fire); #23949, #23951, #23953 (18:20Z fire); #23926, #23939, #23912 (19:20Z fire; #23926 had waited on close-cards' open-PR guard until seat 2's PR #24000 merged). All 17 records are closed. Next: the follow-up ledger card (20:17Z fire), then #23878's close-out. Defect cards and #23950 are never closed by this seat.
- The 7 cloud sessions of the main run and #23879 are archived (14:08Z); the recheck slice is archived too.
- PR #24000's re-run named three product defects for seat 2 to file. All three have cards: objectstack-ai/objectui#12744 (icon-mode sidebar label covers the item above), #24002 (`os start` MCP stdio host reads `initialize` as the config path), and #23965 (the draft `showcase_approver_bindings` flow fires; filed earlier by this seat's recheck slice). Nothing owed.
- After the last record closes: ONE follow-up ledger card (not a comment on #23950, which devx seat 2 claimed 14:52Z) carrying the 13 stale items from #23879's report, the two carried anchor readings and each area record's checklist-accuracy findings.

**Main-red on this lane:** #23885 (Console Pin Gate: #23784 deleted `checkPageComponentViewData`, pinned objectui still imports it) — diagnosed by seat 2 (`6214926932`), routed by triage; no lane PR arms the queue meanwhile.

**Inherited tails (from the previous holder) — both settled at sit-down:**
- #23625 (closed): the scheduled `docs-deploy.yml` runs on a `main` carrying `42718df38` concluded `success` — 38789207094 (2026-10-15T18:52Z), 38833311346 (2026-10-16T01:06Z), 38864541636 (2026-10-16T07:00Z). Settled green.
- #23593 (closed): Done ② held — `platform-checklist-watchdog.yml` run 38842979598 (2026-10-16T02:56Z, schedule) concluded `success` and filed nothing.

**Standing states** (carried, not re-read at sit-down): `pm:blocked` #15214; `pm:on-hold` #22034; ruled decision #23177; graded #13980 (p3); ungraded tracking #8249, #7849, #3877.
